readmeHtml:
IPTV

Collection of publicly available IPTV (Internet Protocol television) channels from all over the world.

Table of contents

  • 🚀 How to use?
  • 📺 Playlists
  • 🗓 EPG
  • 🗄 Database
  • 👨‍💻 API
  • 📚 Resources
  • 💬 Discussions
  • ❓ FAQ
  • 🛠 Contribution
  • ⚖ Legal
  • © License

How to use?

Simply paste the link to one of the playlists into any video player that supports live streaming and press Open.

Playlists

The main playlist containing all channels available in the repository can be found at:

https://iptv-org.github.io/iptv/index.m3u

Links to other playlists can be found in the PLAYLISTS.md file.

EPG

Electronic Program Guide for most of the channels can be downloaded using utilities published in the iptv-org/epg repository.

Database

All channel data is taken from the iptv-org/database repository. If you find any errors please open a new issue there.

API

The API documentation can be found in the iptv-org/api repository.

Resources

Links to other useful IPTV-related resources can be found in the iptv-org/awesome-iptv repository.

Discussions

If you have a question or idea, welcome to the Discussions.

FAQ

The answers to the most popular questions can be found in the FAQ.md file.

Contribution

Please make sure to read the Contributing Guide before sending an issue or making a pull request.

And thank you to everyone who has already contributed!

Backers

Contributors

Legal

No video files are stored in this repository. The repository simply contains user-submitted links to publicly available video stream URLs, which to the best of our knowledge have been intentionally made publicly by the copyright holders. If any links in these playlists infringe on your rights as a copyright holder, they may be removed by opening an issue. However, note that we have no control over the destination of the link, and just removing the link from the playlist will not remove its contents from the web. Note that linking does not directly infringe copyright because no copy is made on the site providing the link, and thus this is not a valid reason to send a DMCA notice to GitHub. To remove this content from the web, you should contact the web host that's actually hosting the content (not GitHub, nor the maintainers of this repository).

License

aiSummary.oneLiner: A massive, community-maintained collection of publicly available IPTV channels from around the world.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: This repository serves as a centralized, open-source database curating thousands of publicly accessible Internet Protocol television (IPTV) channels globally. It organizes streaming links into ready-to-use M3U playlists, allowing users to watch live broadcasts across virtually any modern media player. The project goes beyond merely listing URLs by maintaining a robust ecosystem that includes an automated Electronic Program Guide (EPG) to fetch scheduling data and a comprehensive API for developer integration. By continuously verifying and categorizing streams by country, language, and category, the community ensures a highly reliable and extensively documented free television resource.
keyFeatures: Extensive M3U Playlists: Provides thousands of verified live streaming links structured into standard M3U files compatible with VLC, Kodi, and other players.
Global Categorization: Meticulously sorts channels by country, language, and content category to enable rapid discovery.
Electronic Program Guide: Integrates with dedicated EPG repositories to automatically supply accurate scheduling information for the majority of channels.
Developer API: Exposes a standardized REST API allowing third-party applications to easily query the underlying channel database.
Community Driven Validation: Relies on thousands of contributors to constantly test, update, and remove dead streaming links to maintain high reliability.
Strict Open Source Focus: Strictly curates only publicly available, legal streaming sources to maintain project integrity.

useCases.title: Cross-Platform Viewing
useCases.description: Users load the master M3U playlist into VLC media player to instantly access live news and entertainment from hundreds of international broadcasters.

useCases.title: Third-Party App Development

useCases.title: Language Immersion
useCases.description: Language learners filter the repository to stream localized television stations, providing real-time audio immersion in their target language.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: This project is built for cord-cutters, media center enthusiasts, language learners, and developers needing a reliable, open database of global IPTV streams.
